'''Joseph Lipman''' (born June 15, 1938)<ref>''American Men and Women of Science'', Thomson Gale 2004</ref> is a Canadian-American mathematician, working in [[algebraic geometry]].

Lipman graduated from the [[University of Toronto]] with a bachelor's degree in 1960 and then went to [[Harvard University]], receiving his master's degree in 1961. He then earned a Ph.D. there in 1965 under the supervision of [[Oscar Zariski]]. In 1965 he was an assistant professor at [[Queen's University at Kingston|Queen's University]] in Kingston and in 1966 was an assistant professor at the [[Purdue University]], where he became professor in 1971. From 1987 to 1992, there, he was head of the mathematics department. He was a member of the MSRI and visiting scholar at the [[University of Cambridge]] and the [[University of Nice]] and a visiting professor at the [[Columbia University]] and Harvard University.

He specializes in [[singularity theory]] in algebraic geometry.<ref>{{cite book |first=M. |last=Artin |chapter=Lipman's Proof of Resolution of Singularities for Surfaces |title=Arithmetic Geometry |editor-first=Gary |editor-last=Cornell |editor2-first=Joseph H. |editor2-last=Silverman |editor-link2=Joseph H. Silverman |location=New York |publisher=Springer |year=1986 |isbn=0-387-96311-1 |pages=267–287 }}</ref>

In 1958, while studying at the University of Toronto, he became a Putnam Fellow both in the spring and fall [[William Lowell Putnam Mathematical Competition]]s.<ref name="MMA">{{cite web |title=Putnam Competition Individual and Team Winners |url=http://www.maa.org/programs/maa-awards/putnam-competition-individual-and-team-winners |publisher=[[Mathematical Association of America]] |access-date=December 10, 2021 |archive-date=March 12, 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140312205244/http://www.maa.org/programs/maa-awards/putnam-competition-individual-and-team-winners |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 1982 he received the [[Jeffery–Williams Prize]]. He is a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2013-11-24.</ref>

== Writings ==
* Collected Papers of Joseph Lipman. Queen's Papers in Pure and Applied Mathematics, vol. 117, Queen's University Press, Kingston, Ontario, 2000.
* Editor with [[Herwig Hauser]], [[Frans Oort]], Adolfo Quirós: Resolution of singularities. A research textbook in tribute to Oscar Zariski. Birkhäuser, Basel 2000, {{ISBN|3-7643-6178-6}}. (Progress in Mathematics. volume 181.)
* {{cite book |chapter=Introduction to the Resolution of Singularities |editor-first=David |editor-last=Mumford |editor-link=David Mumford |title=Algebraic Geometry (Arcata 1974) |series=Proc. Symp. Pure Math. |volume=29 |publisher=American Mathematical Society |year=1975 }}
* {{cite journal |title=Desingularization of Two-Dimensional Schemes |journal=[[Annals of Mathematics]] |volume=107 |year=1978 |pages=151–207 |jstor=1971141 |last1=Lipman |first1=Joseph |issue=2 |doi=10.2307/1971141 }}
